description: allowedCommands is the allowlist for repository postUpgradeTasks. It is set only inside a repositories[] entry, never at the top level, so it applies to that one repository: every other autodiscovered repository keeps the default empty list and runs no commands. An autodiscovered repository that matches a repositories[] entry takes that entry's settings (see https://docs.renovatebot.com/self-hosted-configuration/#repositories).

An entry runs that repository's own code (whatever its scripts contain on the branch being updated) from Renovate's checkout, whose git remote carries this runner's org-wide token. Adding a repository here means trusting everyone who can merge to it with that token. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/security-and-permissions/#trusting-repository-developers.
